subject.title: [Feature]: Control UI should show compact run progress for long or multi-agent tasks

question: Which canonical gateway/session activity contract should the Control UI use for compact active-run progress?
rationale: The requested UI needs state beyond current `status` and `hasActiveRun`, and related open issues/PRs propose different API and presentation boundaries that require maintainer product/API direction.

options.title: Define the activity contract first
options.body: Approve the `sessions.activity.*` or equivalent Gateway event/RPC semantics, including activity versions, attention states, stale handling, and child rollup, then build the Control UI strip on top of it.

options.title: Adopt a narrowed open PR
options.body: Choose one open implementation candidate and require it to narrow to the agreed API/UX boundary with fresh proof before it becomes the landing path.

options.title: Defer the progress strip
options.body: Keep the current coarse Control UI status while leaving the broader session activity design open for later product/API review.

recommendation.title: Define the activity contract first
recommendation.body: Approve the `sessions.activity.*` or equivalent Gateway event/RPC semantics, including activity versions, attention states, stale handling, and child rollup, then build the Control UI strip on top of it.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to the canonical Gateway activity issue and has recent gateway/protocol-adjacent history, making him the best available owner for the API/product boundary choice.
